errors.location: Example Database and Test Set sections
errors.description: The manuscript does not report checking for overlap between WikiMatrix demonstrations and FLORES+ devtest source sentences. If test sentences or close duplicates occur in the retrieval database, they could be selected as demonstrations and inflate the reported gains attributed to syntax-based selection.
errors.evidence: “We adopt WikiMatrix v1 … as our example database” and “We perform our evaluation on the devtest set of FLORES+”; no cross-corpus overlap check or deduplication is described.
